title: feat(app-shell): Studio read-only posture, a lock in the app chip and one overlay link in the item header (objectui#12453)
body:
Fixes #12453
Clause-②: no

## What changes

A read-only package now says it is read-only twice, the same in every pillar (epic objectui#12446, decision 4):

- **App chip**: after the package name, a 12 px lock and "Read-only" at 11 px in the muted foreground. Its title is the `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` sentence. This replaces the amber badge.
- **Item header**: one amber-tinted link, 28 px, 12 px / 500, with a Layers glyph: "Read-only · Customize with an overlay". It goes to the package's metadata directory through `overlayPath`, now exported from `BuilderLanding` (the route the Studio home's read-only package card uses), built from the open package's id. Its title is the pillar's read-only sentence: Data `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`, or `engine.studio.data.form.layoutBadgeReadOnly` on the Form tab; Access `engine.studio.access.bannerTitleReadOnly`; Automations and Interfaces `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint`.

Retired on a read-only package:

- the Access pillar's "This package's objects · read-only" note
- the read-only title on the Form tab's Layout control (the Layout / Preview control stays plain)
- the Form toolbar's "Read-only package · click a field to view its properties" hint; "Click a field to view its properties" is now each read-only field card's title
- the footer "Edits save as drafts. Publish the package to apply them." on the Data field aside, the Automations configuration aside and both Interfaces properties asides. Nothing replaces it: the chip and the link already say read-only.

Keys: `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyLink` and `engine.studio.designer.fieldTitleReadOnly` are added. `engine.studio.access.bannerReadOnly`, `engine.studio.designer.hintReadOnly` and `engine.studio.designer.hint` (no reader since PR objectui#12501) are removed, in en and zh.

Unchanged on purpose: Publish keeps its outline disabled look and the tooltip-wrapper reason from objectui#12303. The rail's add button stays hidden. "Add record" and record editing stay available, because records are not metadata.

Re-measured on main `9231820` before editing: the full-width banners and the Data rail footer the card lists were already gone. The `readonlyHint` uses on Publish, the Data field rail and the Automations Enabled switch are objectui#12303 reasons for disabled controls (tooltip plus a visually hidden copy), so they stay. `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` needed no edit: the pillar fills the slot at the tab row's right with the link instead of the note.

## Deviations from data-records-readonly.png

1. Automations (flow open) and Access (permission set open): the link sits at the right end of the tab row, inside the same item header, not at the right of the title row. In the title row at 1280 px it cut the labels to "Enroll Memb…" and "Guest (Pub…", the squeeze objectui#12456 measured. The seat accepted this placement. Data, Interfaces and the headers without tabs keep the link in the title row.
2. Link colours: `bg-amber-400/15`, `text-amber-700`, `dark:text-amber-300`, the amber idiom this file already uses, not the artboard's literal hex values. Theme tokens only.
3. Publish keeps its current outline disabled styling (objectui#8219, objectui#12303), not the artboard's 60 % opacity.
4. Records grid, toolbar and footer keep the runtime list's look, per decision D (answered C, comment 6192878850).
5. Acceptance 1 counts visible text. The visually hidden reasons for disabled controls (objectui#12303) also say "Read-only package — …".

## "Read-only" per pillar (HotCRM `app.objectstack.hotcrm`, read-only under objectstack dev, 1280 px)

| Pillar | Visible text | Draft footer | Link href |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Data | 2 | absent | /apps/setup/metadata?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm |
| Automations | 2 | absent | same |
| Interfaces | 2 | absent | same |
| Access | 2 | absent | same |

The counts are the same in light and dark. Clicking the link lands on the package's metadata directory ("All Metadata Types").

## Tests (HEAD 93f035e)

- New: `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyPosture-12453.test.tsx`. For each of the four pillars on a read-only package: the chip has its lock, word and title and no amber; there is exactly one link, with the overlay href; visible "Read-only" appears twice. On a writable package (the control): no chip, no link, zero.
- Updated: `StudioDesignSurface.readOnlyWording-11781.test.tsx` (the pinned sentences are now the link's and the field card's titles; the field aside has no draft footer), `StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124.test.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesReadOnly-11136.test.tsx` (read-only aside: no draft footer; writable control: footer present), and `DataPillar.headerActions-12511.test.tsx` (the read-only control now lists the link).
- 54 files / 318 tests pass: the seven tests the card names, the files above, narrowHeader-12509, both objectui#12303 read-only reasons, walledCatalogReadOnly-12183, packagedItemWriteGate-12169, PermissionMatrixEditor readonly and readonlyHeaderBadge, and every DataPillar, AutomationsPillar, StudioDesignSurface.access, StudioDesignSurface.interfaces and BuilderLanding test file.
- Ablations, each red then restored with `git diff HEAD` empty: link route (posture 4/4 red, both inline and through overlayPath), Form-tab link title, Access link title, field card title, Data link removed (12511 red), chip returned to amber, and the draft footer put back on the Automations, Interfaces and Data asides (each pin red).
- Gates: i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, i18n-dead-keys, changeset presence and new-line-citations all exit 0. The app-shell `type-check` and `build` exit 0 after building the dependency closure. eslint on the touched files: 0 errors. One warning is new: react-refresh/only-export-components on the `overlayPath` export.
